Durm Goroy is a dead human. His hanging corpse is in Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

Involvement

Act Three

Durm Goroy is executed by hanging near the main entrance of Basilisk Gate Barracks in the Lower City. He is executed together with  Florrick (optional) and  Vince Torell by  Fist 'Edge' Arensen. They only show up after some time and are not present upon first entering Lower City.
